benefit_model.cumulative: observed identity-cumulative start-level mean Q per (capture, prefix layout) from the frozen scan analysis, with its 4-start CI and verdict
benefit_model.marginal_final_step: observed adjacent effect bin-r-1.00-1.05 -> base per capture from the frozen scan analysis

break_even_rule.finite: CI(Q) excludes zero and mean Q > 0: N* = C/Q with Fieller 95% interval (t df=3)
break_even_rule.harmful: mean Q <= 0 or CI excludes zero negative: no_finite_beneficial_breakeven
break_even_rule.indeterminate: CI(Q) crosses zero: reported as indeterminate_ci_crosses_zero, never as a finite horizon

cost_model.cross_campaign_independence: cost and benefit come from separate frozen campaigns on the same node; Fieller intervals use the same independence assumption as the frozen stopping analysis spec
cost_model.measured_basis: stopping migration campaign (48 starts, 624 transactions, 31200 forward/reverse pairs): per-capture single-swap combined cost C_single(c) = mean of that capture's 12 single-swap transaction combined means; per-capture identity-to-base multi-batch combined cost C_multi(c); SEs from the frozen 4-start Student-t intervals
cost_model.prefix_batch_estimator: C_batch(c,k) = C_multi(c) * moves_k / moves_base(c), where moves_x is the count of logical experts whose owner rank differs from identity under layout x; linear-in-bytes extrapolation anchored at the measured full-displacement endpoint; flagged as an estimator, never presented as a measurement
cost_model.prefix_sequential_upper_bound: C_seq(c,k) = k * C_single(c) with SE = k * SE_single(c): the cost of applying the first k greedy swaps one measured single-swap transaction at a time; an upper bound because batching was measured to be cheaper per move

horizon_net_benefit.definition: net(c,k,N) = N * Q_cum_mean(c,k) - C_batch(c,k) for N in the frozen horizon grid; descriptive decision readout at point means; rows whose CI crosses zero are flagged indeterminate and never counted as established gains
horizon_net_benefit.optimal_prefix_rule: argmax_k net(c,k,N); ties to the smaller k

interpretation_rules: all signed values preserved; negative benefits reported as harmful actions
a CI crossing zero means compatible-with-zero: the action is indeterminate, not free and not worthless
no slack, fence, or H term is subtracted from any measured effect
migration costs are never subtracted from execution timings inside a measurement; they are compared only at the decision level via break-even and net benefit
no new timing; no refit; no subset selection
stopping decisions should follow expected benefit versus amortized cost over the intended horizon, not an assumed universal zero-gain deadzone
purpose: compare low-gain placement actions against actually measured migration costs: break-even horizons for adopting each greedy-prefix layout from identity, for the final marginal step into base, and horizon-indexed expected net benefit, using only frozen measured campaigns (no new timing, no refit)

refreeze_note.reason: first freeze omitted the analyzer hash binding; re-frozen before any comparison was computed
